question:
There is a song in which the backup dancers wear black-and-white striped clothes. What colors are the flags that some dancers wave?
(A) White, yellow, blue and black
(B) Purple, green, yellow and black
(C) Orange, yellow, white and black
(D) Red, yellow, blue and black
final_answer_raw:
The video features segments from Britney Spears' Blackout Tour. Around the 3594-second mark, there is a group of dancers on stage. One dancer is wearing bright red pants, and another dancer to her right is wearing black-and-white vertically striped pants (similar to zebra print). In the background of this shot, other performers/dancers appear to be holding or wearing items of various colors. Specifically, looking at the background figures, there appear to be elements of **red**, **yellow** (or gold/yellowish green), and **blue**. The dominant black is in the striped pants. This combination corresponds to option D.

(D)
